description: Translate text from one language to another with no API key required. Source defaults to automatic language detection when omitted. Returns the translated text, the detected source language (when auto-detected), and a match-quality score (1.0 = exact translation-memory match, lower = machine-translated). Language codes are ISO 639-1 (e.g. "en", "de", "ja", "zh-CN").

source.description: Source language code, e.g. "en". Omit to auto-detect.

name: mymemory_translate
